protocol_metadata.about: crvUSD is a decentralized, over-collateralized stablecoin minted via the crvUSD Factory. Users deposit collateral (ETH, wBTC, etc.) into market-specific Controller contracts to borrow crvUSD. Each market has an LLAMMA (liquid liquidation AMM) for smooth liquidations. The protocol is governed by Curve DAO via CRV token voting, with an Aragon voting app enforcing a 7-day timelock and an Emergency DAO (5-of-9 Gnosis Safe) holding pause authority.
